1.consolidated_definition: Pedazo de cuero o de tela de fieltro que se coloca entre dos cuerpos que se rozan , para evitar que éstos se dañen o se desgasten.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Piece of leather or felt cloth placed between two bodies that rub against each other, to prevent them from being damaged or worn out.
